{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_count}')

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
valid_orders = df[completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}')

# Return total_revenue
total_revenue"}
